messages:
incident-bot: ALERT — api-gateway-eu-west reporting sudden 502/504 surge, 5xx rate jumped from ~3% to ~46% in last 60s. p95 latency increased, errors concentrated on /v2/stream and /v1/generate endpoints. paging oncall.

eric: oncall. acknowledging. dropping into thread.

marta: seeing same on dashboards. spike starts at ~10:14 UTC. 502s cluster-wide, not just single node. may correlate with a traffic-split change rolled at 10:13.

alex: i'm rolling traffic-split back to previous config (set new split to 0%). starting now.

infra-bot: autoscaler events: instance count +38% in 2m, queue depth x3, instance CPU 92%.

sre-team: initiating mitigation: enable upstream circuit-breaker for ingress-eu-1, threshold 30% 5xx -> temporarily cut traffic to problematic upstream.

support: customer-impact check: initial query to billing shows ~25% of active tenants have >=20% failed requests; two customers filed support tickets.

marta: rollback applied. asking to wait 45s for drain + health checks.

alex: quick debug curl from probe -> getting 502s. snippet below:

```
curl -s -D - -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.example/v2/stream -I
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: envoy
X-Request-Id: 3f2b1a
```

alex: also seeing repeated upstream timeout logs: "upstream timeout awaiting headers" to model-service-01.

ben-route: @alex @marta ack. backend team investigating connection pool exhaustion on model-service-01 — ramping conn limit and restarting pool now.

infra-bot: backend pool restart initiated for model-service-01 (rolling restart 2/3 nodes)

eric: while backend restarts, please enable temporary request-level rate limiting for /v2/stream (20rps per src) and divert heavy clients to fallback route ingress-eu-0. Can someone flip that?

sre-team: applying rate-limit rule and updating route: divert 40% traffic to ingress-eu-0. will monitor.

marta: after diversion and rate-limit, 5xx dropped: 46% -> 9% within 90s. p95 latency dropping back toward baseline.

support: updating status page: "Partial outage for API requests in EU-West; mitigation in progress. Some requests may return 502/504. Investigating." :loudspeaker:

alex: backend restart completed. connection errors fall to near zero in logs.

infra-bot: metrics snapshot: 5xx rate now 1.9%, queue depth normalized, instance count scaling back to baseline.

eric: nice work. please keep current mitigations (rate-limit + 40% diversion) for 10 more minutes while we stabilize, then gradually remove.

ben-route: increased model-service conn pool config pushed, will follow with a small loadtest.

marta: I captured a short log window that shows a spike of DNS resolution latency coincident with traffic-split change — filing as a hypothesis.

alex: performing staged rollback of diversion at 1m increments.

sre-team: diversion removed, rate-limit lifted, steady state 5xx < 2% for 5m.

support: customers receiving updates. no new high-severity tickets in last 20m.

eric: handing off to morning oncall in 20m — owners for post-incident followup: marta (root cause lead) + alex (rollback/runbook owner). please record timeline and add to incidents board.

marta: agreed. preliminary action items: add runbook entry for traffic-split rollback (zeroing canary), add monitoring for conn-pool exhaustion on model-service, add DNS resolution latency alert.

system-note: created incident task: INCIDENT-5321117777 — owners marta, alex. severity P1 -> downgraded to P2 after stabilization.

eric: closing active command channel. will open postmortem doc and set a follow-up meeting. thanks all. :thumbsup:
